title: Software Engineer
description: Develop scalable web applications and software systems using Python, Java, C++, and modern microservices architecture. Focus on algorithmic optimization, data structures, clean code, and API design.
key_responsibilities: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define software requirements
Debug, test, and deploy applications to production environments

career_roadmap.focus: Master core syntax, version control, unit testing, and component architecture.
Lead feature implementations, perform code reviews, and optimize system performance.
Architect distributed systems, mentor junior engineers, and drive tech stack decisions.

title: Data Scientist
description: Extract valuable business intelligence and actionable insights from structured and unstructured data using Python, R, machine learning, and statistical analytics. Build predictive models and data visualizer dashboards.
key_responsibilities: Develop predictive machine learning models and regression pipelines
Clean, explore, and analyze high-dimensional business data
Communicate data insights to stakeholders using clear visualizations

career_roadmap.focus: Data cleaning, SQL querying, and descriptive analytics dashboards.
Feature engineering, ML modeling, hypothesis testing, and model deployment.
Design enterprise AI strategy, MLOps infrastructure, and deep learning models.

recommended_courses: Deep Learning Specialization by Andrew Ng

title: UX/UI Designer
description: Craft intuitive, accessible, and delightful user interfaces and user experiences for web and mobile platforms. Produce wireframes, interactive prototypes, user journey maps, and design systems using Figma and Adobe XD.
key_responsibilities: Conduct user interviews, usability testing, and persona research
Create high-fidelity interactive mockups and component libraries in Figma
Collaborate closely with frontend developers to ensure pixel-perfect execution

career_roadmap.focus: Wireframing, UI polish, component library maintenance, and usability testing.
End-to-end product design, user flow optimization, and design system governance.
UX strategy, brand identity alignment, and managing design teams.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Protect IT networks, cloud infrastructure, and sensitive data from cyber threats. Monitor security incidents, conduct vulnerability assessments, implement firewall protocols, and perform incident response.
key_responsibilities: Monitor security event logs and analyze real-time threats
Conduct vulnerability penetration testing and patch management
Develop security compliance guidelines and employee security awareness training

career_roadmap.focus: SOC monitoring, log management, and baseline security compliance.
Threat hunting, incident response, penetration testing, and network hardening.
Enterprise security policies, threat governance, and risk mitigation.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Design, analyze, and test mechanical components, thermal systems, and manufacturing machinery. Utilize 3D CAD modeling (SolidWorks, AutoCAD), finite element analysis (FEA), and materials science principles.
key_responsibilities: Develop 3D mechanical schematics and production blueprints
Perform stress, thermal, and structural simulations using FEA software
Supervise mechanical assembly testing and quality control inspections

career_roadmap.focus: CAD drafting, component tolerance checking, and testing assistance.
Product development, thermal modeling, and prototype validation.
Engineering project management, vendor management, and R&D strategy.

title: Financial Analyst
description: Evaluate investment portfolios, analyze corporate financial metrics, build complex forecasting models in Excel, and generate strategic risk/reward reporting for executive decision-making.
key_responsibilities: Build discounted cash flow (DCF) models and valuation forecasts
Analyze corporate balance sheets, cash flow statements, and market trends
Prepare investment thesis recommendations for portfolio managers

career_roadmap.focus: Financial statement analysis, data entry, and variance reporting.
Complex financial modeling, M&A evaluation, and capital budgeting.
Corporate capital management, investor relations, and strategic growth.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description: Plan, run, and optimize omnichannel digital marketing campaigns spanning SEO, Google Ads (PPC), social media advertising, content creation, and analytics tracking to drive brand engagement.
key_responsibilities: Optimize website content and metadata for search engine rankings
Manage Google Ads and Meta ad spend campaigns with ROI tracking
Analyze campaign conversion funnel performance using Google Analytics

career_roadmap.focus: Social media scheduling, blog drafting, and basic ad management.
PPC budget allocation, SEO audits, conversion rate optimization.
Brand expansion strategy, customer acquisition cost reduction, and team leadership.

recommended_courses: Google Digital Marketing & E-commerce Professional Certificate

title: Civil Engineer
description: Design and manage civil infrastructure projects such as transportation networks, structural buildings, bridges, and stormwater management systems. Inspect field construction to comply with structural codes.
key_responsibilities: Create structural blueprints and 2D/3D CAD site designs
Conduct site inspections and monitor safety standard adherence
Calculate material requirements, cost estimates, and project timelines

career_roadmap.focus: Field inspection, quantity surveying, and CAD drafting support.
Structural modeling, permit processing, and project management.
Mega-infrastructure planning, regulatory approval, and contract management.

title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
description: Build, train, and deploy advanced artificial intelligence algorithms, neural networks, and NLP systems. Utilize PyTorch, TensorFlow, vector databases, and MLOps tools to bring AI solutions to life.
key_responsibilities: Train large language models (LLMs) and neural networks on specialized datasets
Build RAG pipelines and vector similarity indexing for intelligent agents
Deploy models to cloud endpoints with Docker and Kubernetes

career_roadmap.focus: Data preprocessing, basic model training, API wrapping.
Custom neural architecture design, fine-tuning, RAG optimization, MLOps.
Generative AI roadmap, foundation model research, enterprise AI integration.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description: Design, deploy, and maintain high-availability cloud environments on AWS, Azure, or GCP. Implement infrastructure as code (Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and monitoring.
key_responsibilities: Automate cloud resource provisioning using Terraform and Ansible
Maintain automated CI/CD build and release pipelines
Ensure 99.99% system uptime, disaster recovery, and auto-scaling performance

career_roadmap.focus: CI/CD maintenance, Docker container management, cloud administration.
Infrastructure automation, multi-cloud strategy, cost optimization.
Enterprise cloud strategy, reliability engineering leadership.
